en: Somebody downstairs wanted to battle me. It's no place for the timid down there, so watch yourself.
Team Rocket again! Can't they ever leave people in peace?
You seem a decent sort. However did you end up with Team Rocket?
There are shops down the stairs, but Trainers too. I'm too nervous to go down.
Everyone who worked down here has gone. Nobody wants trouble with Team Rocket.
Oh... Of course. Team Rocket can use the passage as well as anyone.
